title: 第1743章 大量源皇族人诞生第1742章 闭关冲击源皇七层
content_zh:
修炼无日月。
水界珠内，光阴树的落叶在密室外堆了一层又一层。
四旺的观测台上铁蜡木标签已多到快插不下，
李法瞳瞳孔中的空间古神血透明光芒，
在一次次冲击后终于摸到了四品巅峰的门槛，
小七丹田中的涅盘火种恢复了十成能量，
暗金纹路在火种表面，交织成一幅完整的涅盘法则图腾。
李衍道在密室中始终保持盘坐姿态，土系法则加固过的岩砖地面上，已积了薄薄一层，从密室外飘进来的光阴树落叶碎屑。
他将全部心神分为两股，一股持续推动神国六层的源力积累，向源皇后期迈进，一股持续淬炼三生神血向九品进发。
两股心神在百倍加速下同步推进，互不干扰，又通过至尊法则循环，和神血核心之间的共鸣互相催化。
外界数十年，弹指而过。
极北冰原的暴风雪在这数十年里从未停歇。
正南分阵台的修复工程在铁焚源皇的主持下已完成大半。
三根被摧毁的阵柱中已有两根重新矗立在冻土上，第三根的熔岩精金骨架，也已在铁焚源皇的熔炉中，锻造了数十年。
极北冰原的极寒环境，对熔岩精金的冷却速度极难控制，铁焚源皇为此专门在分阵台旁边，搭建了一座小型熔炉工坊，工坊四壁由火系法则阵盘维持恒温。
他的胡子上永远结着冰碴，手指上的冻疮在火系法则，和极寒环境的反复拉扯中裂了又愈合、愈合了又裂，但他盯着熔炉中，那根正在缓慢成形的阵柱骨架的眼神，和数十年前第一次点燃熔炉时一模一样。
秦源皇在主阵台上守了数十年。
三座分阵台的传送通道在这数十年里，经历了多次小规模邪神残部的试探性进攻。
魂祭军团的一个中队在多年前，曾试图从东南分阵台侧翼潜入，被阎的影刺暗哨提前发现，雷亟源皇的感应雷阵在对方进入中圈聚雷阵范围时，同时激活一百零八道雷系阵柱中的七十二道，将那支魂祭中队轰成了神魂碎片。
命祭军团的一支侦察小队，在又数年后从西南冰河故道摸进来，被项天齐亲自带队堵在冰河故道的尽头全歼。

命祭军团的防御力确实惊人，一个十人侦察小队顶着百战域护域队，整整一个编队的围攻，撑了大半个时辰才被攻破防御。
血祭军团的主力始终驻扎在极北冰原外围，血喉在这数十年里没有发动过一次大规模进攻。
骨祭军团的苏醒信号，在多年前就已从古冥旧战场深处传出，但苏醒后便迟迟没有下一步动静。
魂祭军团和命祭军团的残部虽然已陆续抵达，但都是零散的中队规模，主力还在路上。
血喉需要等残部全部到齐才能发动总攻，他对此极有耐心。
对于一个在封印中，沉睡了上千万年的血祭军团副统领来说，几十年不过是眨眼一瞬。
骨翼源帝在正南分阵台战斗后，便返回了外部加固节点，重新与青木源帝并肩加固封印外层。
两人交替轮换，一人加固时另一人调息恢复，配合极为默契。
骨翼神族旁支在祖地的夺权行动，在这数十年里始终处于僵持状态。
大长老以骨令召唤的源帝投影，虽只剩最后一次使用机会，但旁支首领请来的轮回殿主源尊旧部，也在骨翼祖地外围犹豫不决，显然不敢在骨翼源帝还活着的情况下真的动手。
双方就这么隔空对峙了数十年，谁也不敢迈出第一步。
神族地域深处，轮回殿主的闭关密室。
深紫色的轮回法则雾气，在密室中已凝成了液态。
他的修为在轮回神体先天优势，和神王级法则感悟的双重推动下，已在这一日突破了源尊中期的最后一道屏障，正式踏入源尊后期。
源尊后期的轮回法则，在他体内运转时，不再像中期那样分成了主脉络和分支脉络，而是全部融为一体。
他体内的每一条经脉、每一寸骨骼、每一滴神血都被轮回法则浸润到了细胞层面。
轮回法则不再是需要主动催动的外力，而是成了他身体的本能，如同呼吸，如同心跳。
这种状态下的轮回神体，正面战力已超越了源尊巅峰的范畴。
源尊境界内已不存在能与他对等的对手。
轮回殿主睁开眼睛。

深紫色的轮回法则光晕在瞳孔中一闪而逝，随即敛入眼底，瞳色恢复了正常。
但瞳孔深处多了一道细微的紫色光圈，光圈每几息轮转一圈，每一次轮转都代表着他体内的轮回法则，完成了一次自发循环。
他从阵盘上站起来，液态轮回法则从他身上滑落，落在地面上溅起一圈无声的紫色涟漪。
“骨祭军团那边，进展如何？”
密室外一名等候了不知多久的旧部，立刻将一份最新的情报玉简呈上：
content_en:
There is no sun or moon in cultivation.
Inside the Water Boundary Pearl, the fallen leaves of the Time Tree were piled up layer after layer outside the secret room.
There are so many ironwood labels on Siwang's observation platform that they can no longer be inserted.
The ancient divine blood of space shines transparently in Li Fatong's pupils,
After repeated shocks, I finally reached the threshold of the fourth level peak.
The Nirvana fire in Xiaoqi's dantian recovered 100% of its energy.
Dark gold lines are intertwined on the surface of the fire to form a complete totem of the Law of Nirvana.
Li Yandao always maintained a cross-legged posture in the secret room. On the rock brick floor reinforced by the earth law, a thin layer of fallen leaves from the Time Tree floated in from outside the secret room.
He divided all his mind into two parts. One part continued to promote the accumulation of source power on the sixth level of the Kingdom of God, moving towards the source queen stage, and the other part continued to refine the blood of the three-life gods to move towards the ninth level.
The two minds advance simultaneously at a hundredfold acceleration without interfering with each other. They circulate through the Supreme Law and catalyze each other through the resonance with the divine blood core.
Decades from the outside world pass by with a snap of a finger.
The blizzards in the Arctic ice sheet have never stopped in these decades.
The restoration project of the Zhengnan branch platform has been mostly completed under the auspices of Emperor Tie Fenyuan.
Two of the three destroyed formation pillars have re-erected on the frozen soil, and the lava fine gold skeleton of the third one has been forged in the furnace of Emperor Tiefenyuan for decades.
The extremely cold environment of the Arctic ice sheet makes it extremely difficult to control the cooling rate of molten gold. For this purpose, Emperor Tiefenyuan built a small furnace workshop next to the formation platform. The four walls of the workshop were maintained at a constant temperature by fire law array disks.
His beard is always covered with ice, and the chilblains on his fingers have cracked and healed, healed and cracked under the repeated pull of the fire law and the extreme cold environment, but the way he stared at the slowly forming pillar skeleton in the furnace was exactly the same as when he first lit the furnace decades ago.
Emperor Qin Yuan had been guarding the main formation for decades.
In the past few decades, the transmission channels of the three formation platforms have experienced many small-scale tentative attacks by the remnants of the evil god.
Many years ago, a squadron of the Soul Sacrifice Legion tried to sneak in from the flank of the southeastern formation, but was discovered in advance by Yan's Shadow Thorn Secret Sentence. When the opponent entered the range of the central thunder gathering array, Lei Jiyuanhuang's induction thunder array simultaneously activated 72 of the 108 thunder array pillars, blasting the Soul Sacrifice squadron into soul fragments.
A few years later, a reconnaissance team from the Life Sacrifice Corps came in from the Glacier Trail in the southwest, and was blocked at the end of the Glacier Trail by Xiang Tianqi himself and annihilated.
The defensive power of the Life Sacrifice Corps was indeed astonishing. A ten-man reconnaissance team was besieged by a whole formation of the Baizhan Domain Guard Team, and it took more than half an hour before the defense was breached.
The main force of the Blood Sacrifice Legion has always been stationed on the periphery of the Far North Icefield, and the Bloodthroat has not launched a large-scale attack in these decades.
The awakening signal of the Bone Sacrifice Legion came from the depths of the ancient battlefield many years ago, but after awakening, there has been no further movement.
Although the remnants of the Soul Sacrifice Legion and the Life Sacrifice Legion have arrived one after another, they are all scattered squadrons, and the main force is still on the way.
Bloodthroat needs to wait for all the remaining troops to arrive before launching a general attack, and he is very patient about this.
For a deputy commander of the Blood Sacrifice Legion who had been sleeping in a seal for tens of millions of years, decades were just a blink of an eye.
After the Bone Wing Emperor fought at the due south formation platform, he returned to the external reinforcement node and worked side by side with Aoki Source Emperor to reinforce the outer layer of the seal.
The two of them alternated, with one person strengthening while the other adjusted his breath to recover, and the cooperation was extremely tacit.
The Bonewing God Clan's branch's efforts to seize power in their ancestral land have been in a stalemate for decades.
Although the Source Emperor's projection summoned by the Great Elder with the bone order only had one last chance to use it, the former leader of the Samsara Palace, Yuan Zun, invited by the leader of the side branch, was also hesitant outside the Bone Wing Ancestral Land, and obviously did not dare to really take action when the Bone Wing Source Emperor was still alive.
The two sides have been confronting each other for decades, and no one canDare to take the first step.
Deep in the territory of the Gods, there is the secret retreat room of the Lord of the Samsara Palace.
The dark purple mist of the Law of Reincarnation has condensed into a liquid state in the secret room.
Driven by the innate advantages of the Samsara Divine Body and his understanding of the God-King-level laws, his cultivation has broken through the last barrier in the middle stage of Yuan Zun on this day and officially entered the late stage of Yuan Zun.
When the law of reincarnation in the later stage of Yuan Zun was running in his body, it was no longer divided into main veins and branch veins like it was in the middle period, but all merged into one.
Every meridian, every inch of bone, and every drop of divine blood in his body has been infiltrated to the cellular level by the law of reincarnation.
The law of reincarnation is no longer an external force that needs to be actively activated, but has become an instinct of his body, like breathing and heartbeat.
The frontal combat power of the Samsara Divine Body in this state has exceeded the scope of the peak of Yuan Zun.
There is no opponent who can equal him in the realm of Yuan Zun.
The Lord of Samsara Palace opened his eyes.
The dark purple halo of the Law of Reincarnation flashed in the pupils, and then converged into the eyes, and the color of the pupils returned to normal.
But there is a subtle purple halo deep in the pupil. The halo rotates once every few breaths. Each rotation represents the law of reincarnation in his body, completing a spontaneous cycle.
He stood up from the formation disk, and the liquid law of reincarnation slipped from his body, falling to the ground and splashing a circle of silent purple ripples.
"How is the progress with the Bone Sacrifice Legion?"
An old subordinate who had been waiting outside the secret room for an unknown amount of time immediately presented a jade slip of the latest information:
